nom: VICHY Mineral 89 Daily Face Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

avis.titre: Last a long time, great price point. Vichy quality= Great Quality.
avis.texte: Can’t live without it. I am subscribed to this cream. It does have a slight fragrance but it is mild and delicate. It is lightweight, goes a long way, it is not greasy and moisturizes beautifully. Does not cause skin irritation, although I make sure to not apply it near my eyes. Long shelf life, expiration date is stated on the cardboard packaging box. Good value for the money.

I've used this for 3 week just before bed. I believe it has helped with moisturizing my skin a bit. Especially since the cold weather. Although, I'm not fond of the scent and because of this reason, it's becoming more difficult to apply it. It doesn't smell bad, just strong. Reminds me of Jergens. It also seems to leave a light vapor feeling once applied. The jar comes full and I don't need much to apply. Not sure if that's a good thing in this case, due to becoming unable to tolerate the scent🫤.

avis.titre: The cream moisturizes but does not feel greasy.The cream moisturizes but does not feel greasy.
avis.texte: I got a small sample and found that it worked well. So I purchased this full size bottle. The cream moisturizes but does not feel greasy. It helps remove fine lines. I like the mild floral fragrance that is not overwhelming.

This is a great night cream, my only gripe is it smells exactly like the product FDS (feminine deodorant spray) and after working around women who wear it like it’s body mist, I don’t like it. Placing rose hip oil on top of this removes the smell, but if you don’t mind that fragrance, it’s a overall win.

avis.titre: The best night cream I've tried
avis.texte: Love this night cream. The texture and the feel on my skin is great. And my face looks glossy and feel more soft and smooth the next morning. So glad i tried this cream. I'll keep buying it.
Wow. My skin genuinely felt softer and hydrated by morning! The texture is so silky smooth and the scent is lovely. Will 100% be using this as my regular night cream from now on.
J’ai essayé plusieurs crèmes depuis les dernières années, mais je crois avoir enfin trouvé MA crème parfaite! Une belle hydratation sans fini graisseux, en prime elle sent bonne.
Mi è piaciuta davvero tanto. È una crema notte piacevole da applicare, lascia la pelle ben idratata e dà una bella sensazione di comfort al risveglio. La consiglio e la ricomprerei volentieri.

avis.titre: Love Vichy Laboratories - Great Product and Valve
avis.texte: Great Value for the Money, no fragrance very neutral, lots of moisture and lasts, not greasy blends in very well.

This is a lightweight gel moisturizer that would be perfect for people with oily skin. I found that it spread well, sunk in quickly and didn't leave behind any type of sticky feeling. I will say that for me, personally, I need a bit more moisture but this seems like a great layering moisturizer or for people who have very oily skin. It has a strong clean scent, I found it nice but it might be too much for some people. The product is a bit smaller than I anticipated, however I found that I didn't need to use a ton of product because it spreads easily. I had no irritation or breakouts after using.

This VICHY Minéral 89 Moisture Recovery Night Cream is a real treat for my dry and sometimes sensitive skin. The box had a little circle seal but the jar had none. The jar is beautiful in color and has a nice shape. The cream is a pale blue and is very luxurious in texture. It goes on my skin smoothly and feels silky and cool. This is a thick cream which is just perfect for my aging skin. It does not leave a greasy or oily feel, my skin soaks it right up. I’ve experienced the benefits of hyaluronic acid before but never melatonin in a face cream. So far so good! The scent is light and pleasant. I’m very happy to have found this product.

avis.titre: Smells nice and feels soft and silky
avis.texte: Very pretty, lightweight cream. There is a light fresh crisp smell to it that is very soothing. The cream soaks in quickly without any residue or film. My skin feels very hydrated. The amount I had on my finger was enough for my whole face so a little goes a long way. I did feel calm and relaxed after about an hour so the melatonin part definitely works for me! So far this is a great value for the price!
I recently received my order, but unfortunately, the item appears to have been used and was not properly packaged. This is disappointing, as I was expecting a new product in original condition.

Smells so good! Very light and fresh scent. The cream almost has a gel consistency to it while still being a cream. It has a light blue color to it. A little goes a long way and it goes on smooth and isn’t too sticky very moisturizing. I used during the day as well as at night to restore barrier and moisturize. Feels very luxurious. No adverse side effects or anything negative to report. Skin looks more hydrated already. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Feels good but not special.  High niacinimide content is promising, but feel is average.
avis.texte: I expected this to feel like a luxury cream, but it actually feels like some much less expensive brands that I've used. Check out the photos to see the texture. It looks thick, but quickly dissolves into a water like serum. It does a great job of moisturizing skin with a light scent that isn't offensive, but as the wife of a dermatologist, I'm not sure it's a good value for the money. I am impressed that niacinimide is very high on the ingredients list, so it may perform very well over time. I will keep using it an report back.

When i opened the container, it was possibly disintegrated or old? I am not sure exactly what caused the big hole in the middle, but I haven't received any moisturizers that have looked like this before. I really don't care for the smell. As far as moisturizing, it does nothing out of the ordinary, it soaks in and dissappears, doesn't really hydrate all that much.
